content: Supabase JS v2 can be loaded via CDN without a bundler using the official UMD build: <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>, which exposes createClient on the global 'supabase' object. jsDelivr's +esm build (dynamic ESM transform) is documented to break with 'Cannot read properties of null (reading AuthClient)' due to submodules using export default null with named exports only -- avoid it for browser use. Official docs: supabase.com/docs/reference/javascript/installing.
